body.zh-Hant: 法國國家圖書館權威檔記他生於1859年12月29日的四泉城。該檔稱他為政治家，1914至1920年任墨西哥總統。他於1920年5月21日在特拉斯卡蘭通戈去世。該檔註明他的語言為西班牙文，國別為墨西哥。
body.en: The BnF authority record notes Spanish as his language and Mexico as his country, and gives his birth at Cuatro Ciénegas on 29 December 1859, calls him a statesman and President of Mexico from 1914 to 1920, and records his death at Tlaxcalantongo on 21 May 1920.

heading.zh-Hant: 反烏埃爾塔、總統任期與遇害

body.zh-Hant: 義大利百科全書記他1913年領導反對烏埃爾塔總統的叛亂。1914年8月16日他被選為總統。第一次世界大戰期間，他宣布墨西哥中立。1917年他再次當選總統，但國內叛亂始終未止。在對手展開的新一輪總統競選期間，他被迫離開首都。前往韋拉克魯斯途中，他遭到殺害。
body.en: The Enciclopedia Italiana says he led the 1913 revolt against President Huerta. He was elected president on 16 August 1914, proclaimed neutrality in the World War, and was re-elected in 1917, but internal revolt never died down. During the new presidential campaign run by his opponent he was forced to leave the capital and was assassinated on the way to Veracruz.

body.zh-Hant: 約瑟夫·貝希1887年2月17日生於盧森堡的迪基希。他在埃希特納赫古典中學完成中等教育，之後在瑞士弗里堡大學與巴黎大學修讀法律，1912年取得法學博士，成為律師。
body.en: Joseph Bech was born in Diekirch, Luxembourg, on 17 February 1887. He completed his secondary schooling at the classical lycée in Echternach, then studied law at the universities of Fribourg (Switzerland) and Paris, taking his doctorate in law in 1912 and becoming a lawyer.

heading.en: Deputy, then Minister of Justice and Public Instruction

body.zh-Hant: 1914年，貝希年僅二十七歲便進入議會，是當時下議院最年輕的議員；官方公報列他任議員至1921年。他於1921至1925年擔任司法暨公共教育部長。
body.en: Bech entered parliament in 1914 at the age of twenty-seven, at the time the youngest member of the Chamber of Deputies; the official bulletin lists him as a member of parliament until 1921. From 1921 to 1925 he was Minister of Justice and Public Instruction.

heading.en: Prime minister, foreign minister and exile

body.zh-Hant: 貝希1926至1937年任國務大臣兼政府首相，1929年擔任國際聯盟副主席。1937年起他改任外交暨葡萄種植部長，任期至1953年。1940年5月10日，他隨大公夫人流亡國外。
body.en: Bech was Minister of State and President of the Government from 1926 to 1937 and was Vice-President of the League of Nations in 1929. From 1937 he served as Minister for Foreign Affairs and Viticulture, until 1953. On 10 May 1940 he accompanied the Grand Duchess into exile.

heading.en: San Francisco and the United Nations

body.zh-Hant: 1945年貝希率盧森堡代表團出席舊金山會議，1946年任聯合國政治與一般事務委員會主席。
body.en: In 1945 Bech headed the Luxembourg delegation at the San Francisco Conference, and in 1946 he chaired the UN Commission on Political and General Affairs.

body.zh-Hant: 貝希1953至1958年再度出任首相。1960年獲頒查理曼獎。他於1975年3月8日晚間在盧森堡去世，享年八十八歲。
body.en: Bech was again Prime Minister from 1953 to 1958. He received the Charlemagne Prize in 1960. He died in Luxembourg on the evening of 8 March 1975, aged 88.
